subject: NimblePay — Renew & add subsidiary teams
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@nimblepay.com>, Mike Grant <mike.grant@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NimblePay — Renew & add subsidiary teams

Hi Elena / Mike —

Quick note as we approach your renewal window in early Feb. Thanks again for the steady usage and the feedback from your platform team — the pilot went really well. We wanted to confirm two items so we can get paperwork and keys ready before the renewal:

1) Expansion request: you mentioned onboarding two subsidiaries (NimblePay Retail and NimblePay Rewards) under the same account. We can provision per-app API keys and apply staggered activation to avoid rate spikes.
2) Term adjustment: under the renewal we can offer a 12-month extension with a small per-month committed capacity increase (10% over current baseline) in exchange for consolidated billing and a single addendum covering the subsidiaries.

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm the list of projects/apps, Monica will draft a mutual action plan and outline activation dates.
- We’ll prepare a single addendum that covers the capacity bump & key provisioning schedule for signature.

I’m looping in Lauren (contracts) and Monica from customer success to coordinate timelines. Can you confirm: the two new teams' names, expected peak QPS per team, and whether they need SSO?

Thanks —
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0122

Subject: Re: NimblePay — Renew & add subsidiary teams

Thanks Rishi —

We can confirm the two subsidiaries:
- NimblePay Retail (internal name: nimble-retail)
- NimblePay Rewards (internal name: nimble-rewards)

Estimated peak QPS: 120 for Retail during peak hours, 40 for Rewards. Both teams will need separate API keys and request isolation (they want independent quota tracking).

SSO: Retail will use SAML via Okta; Rewards will start without SSO for the first 90 days.

Couple questions before we commit:
- Can the addendum include staged activation (Retail first, Rewards 4 weeks later)?
- Pricing: is the 10% committed capacity increase billed immediately at renewal or pro-rated for the first month?

File: (attached) NimblePay_request_summary.pdf — quick internal notes.

Elena

Hi Elena —

Great — thanks for the clear numbers. I sketched a short mutual action plan for how we’d sequence this to minimize risk and unblock your platform teams:

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Week 0 (Renewal signed): Addendum executed; billing consolidated.
- Week 1: Provision nimble-retail API keys in staging + SSO config for Okta.
- Week 2: Retail smoke tests (prefix caching enabled; canary traffic at 1% -> 10%).
- Week 4: Retail production cutover; ramp to full traffic.
- Week 6: Provision nimble-rewards API keys in staging; no SSO initially.
- Week 7-8: Rewards smoke + production cutover.

Notes / assumptions:
- We’ll apply per-key quota and per-route dashboards so each team sees separate cost breakdowns.
- The 10% committed increase is modeled off your monthly token baseline. We’ll pro-rate billing for the first partial month if activation happens mid-cycle.
- I’ll include a short checklist for SSO: SP metadata, ACS URL, attribute mappings.

Attached: NimblePay_EXPANSION_MAP.xlsx (contains the proposed key names, staging prefixes, and test windows). Please review and mark any adjustments to capacity or dates.

If that looks OK I’ll ask Lauren to drop the addendum (with the renewal invoice) and we can inline the staged activation schedule.

Thanks —
Monica

--

Thanks team —

Plan looks reasonable. Two quick asks from procurement/finance:
- Can you confirm how the committed capacity increase affects our overage rate? We need a line item in the addendum.
- We prefer consolidated billing but separate internal chargeback strings — can you provide a format for how cost breakdown will be exported (CSV / Looker)?

If those are clear I’m happy to proceed; Elena: I defer to you on exact dates for activation windows.

Mike

Hi Mike / Elena —

Attached is a draft addendum (PDF redline) that:
- Adds nimble-retail and nimble-rewards as covered projects under the existing contract;
- Specifies the 10% committed capacity increase and the overage rate change (overage = committed rate + 25% premium);
- Calls out staged activation windows and per-key quotas.

Attachment: NimblePay_Addendum_Redline.pdf

Billing export: we can provide a nightly CSV with per-key usage + cost columns, and a Looker dashboard that exports the same CSV format for your chargeback process. I’ll include a sample CSV export layout in the final addendum package.

Next steps:
- Please review the redline and return comments by EOD Mon, Jan 25.
- If accepted, we’ll upload the final addendum to DocuSign and aim to execute before Feb 1 (your renewal date).

Lauren
